reason: The action calls find_user_id_by_email with the email the user just supplied, which is exactly the required authentication step before any profile/order information can be provided. Policy requires locating the user id via email or name+zip at the start of the conversation before helping, and this is a read-only lookup tool that does not update the database, so no confirmation is required.
policy_references: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code.
Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
